title: Go channel unbuffered select default branch spinning under high core count
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0832: Go channel unbuffered select default branch spinning under high core count
Repository: `netty/netty`
Category: `Asynchronous Event Loop Deadlocks`
Target File: `src/runtime/chan.go`

#### Problem Description
Select on unbuffered channel with default case burns 100% CPU across 64 cores without yielding thread.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Insert runtime.Gosched() or use exponential backoff in non-blocking select polling loop.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0832.py -q`
expected_invariant: Insert runtime.Gosched() or use exponential backoff in non-blocking select polling loop.
